rows.Operational definition: Governance and management responses reported by nonprofit filing organizations on IRS Form 990.

rows.Operational definition: A source extract associated with an EIN, tax_year and filing metadata.
rows.Interpretation / caution: The same EIN may appear in multiple tax years and potentially in more than one filing within a year.
rows.Basis: CSV contains 19,249 source rows; this is not a count of unique hospitals.

rows.Operational definition: Treat EIN as a text identifier for the filing organization; preserve leading zeroes.
rows.Interpretation / caution: Use EIN for longitudinal grouping; names can change and one EIN can cover multiple facilities.

rows.Operational definition: tax_year is the tax year labeled in the extract; tax_period is the reported period end in YYYYMM.
rows.Interpretation / caution: Do not assume tax_year equals calendar filing date; show both when referencing a specific return.

rows.Operational definition: Object ID and XML filename trace an extracted record to a source filing.
rows.Interpretation / caution: These fields do not by themselves prove a particular filing was the final or amended version.

rows.Operational definition: Status recorded by the source extraction workflow.
rows.Interpretation / caution: The CSV shows status values, but their full pipeline definitions were not provided; do not invent what each status guarantees.

rows.Operational definition: Retain the source response as reported; valid binary comparisons count only explicit Yes and No.
rows.Interpretation / caution: Missing, blank, or unrecognized values are not equivalent to No.
rows.Basis: Applies to Form 990 Part VI response columns.

rows.Interpretation / caution: A blank may be structurally inapplicable; denominator should reflect eligible valid responses.

rows.Operational definition: line_1a_voting_members is the count of voting members reported for the governing body.
rows.Interpretation / caution: Do not equate board size with number of hospitals or employees.

rows.Operational definition: line_1b_independent_members is the reported number of independent voting members.
rows.Interpretation / caution: Independent is an IRS-defined status; not a direct measure of governance quality.

rows.Operational definition: line_3_management_delegation indicates whether management duties were delegated as asked in Part VI line 3.
rows.Interpretation / caution: Yes does not establish outsourcing of every management function, acquisition, or system consolidation.

rows.Operational definition: line_16a_investment_in_joint_venture reports the specific activity involving taxable entities asked about in line 16a.
rows.Interpretation / caution: Does not capture every partnership, affiliation, or merger.

rows.Operational definition: line_4_governing_document_changes flags reported significant changes to governing documents.
rows.Interpretation / caution: A Yes answer does not explain the reason or identify a consolidation; check narrative and filing detail.

rows.Operational definition: line_11b_form_990_review_text contains extracted free-text information about Form 990 review.
rows.Interpretation / caution: Narrative is not directly comparable to a binary Yes/No field without separate text coding.
